Thanks Sam — Wed Oct 6 11:00 PT works for me.

Quick outline for the session (45 min):
1) 5 min — intros & success criteria (Soojin/Sam)
2) 20 min — runtime walkthrough (routing, KV cache, batching, and quantization profiles)
3) 10 min — security & deployment models (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private; KMS/HSM notes)
4) 10 min — Q&A and next steps (procurement & SOW touchpoints)

Pre-demo artifacts I can share:
- SE-Agenda-v2.pdf (agenda + demo runbook)
- FinSecure-Security-Checklist.xlsx (what we can provide and what we need from customer)
- short SOW summary (1 page) — I’ll attach the summary draft to the calendar invite.

Security notes: we can provide SOC2 report excerpts, sample audit-log schema, and an export of token-level telemetry that is redacted for PII. For customers wanting KMS/HSM integration we provide guidance and sample Terraform snippets but the final key material remains customer-managed.

Any special test data you want us to use in the demo? If you can share a sanitized sample (or a small set of sample inputs) ahead of time we’ll pre-load it to reduce demo friction. If not, we’ll demo with our synthetic examples and call out where things differ operationally.

I’ll send a calendar invite once we lock the attendee list.

— Ben
